source_version: Capella (continuously deployed, no discrete version number)

relations.subject: sso:realm
relations.evidence:
Choose to turn on or off group mapping.  
Group mapping allows you to assign roles to SSO users based on which teams map to their SSO group.

relations.subject: sso:realm
relations.evidence:
Choose a default team.  
Capella automatically assigns users to the chosen default team when they do not match any team based on their SSO groups.

notable_absence.finding: Prerequisite gate is generic and unlinked: 'To sign in to the Okta Admin Console as a super admin.' Same pattern as CyberArk/Ping/OneLogin; contrast sso-entra-id.md's linked, named 'Global Administrator'.

cross_component_finding: Okta's SAML flow is the only one that requires placeholder values (Single Sign-On URL, Audience URI) at IdP-app-creation time, later replaced with real Capella values in the 'Complete the Okta Configuration' step - Ping's SAML flow shares this placeholder pattern, but CyberArk, Google Workspace, Entra ID, and OneLogin do not need it. Okta is also the only provider using a case-sensitive caution for its SAML attribute names ('Values entered into the Name column are case-sensitive. Enter them as shown in the table.') and the only one using a distinct 'Group Attribute Statements' UI section (with a regex filter, default '.*') rather than a plain fourth attribute row for the groups claim - functionally equivalent to the other providers' groups mapping, but implemented and documented differently at the IdP-UI level.
